Detailed Description

Base configuration class for the framework.

Every time-related object in the framework (for example oscillators) must refer to a SoundInfo class to query real-time information, such as the sampling rate. Actually this class implements the Singleton pattern, so you can have only a single instance of SoundInfo.

Sets the number of channels.

The default number of channels is defined by CHANNELS in SoundObject.h. If you wish to use a rate which is different from the default, you must set it BEFORE objects are instantiated.
